task.title: Job the robot should do
task.description: A short job name, e.g. "mowing", "gutter cleaning", "floor scrubbing".

searchPhrase.title: Search phrase (optional)
searchPhrase.description: What a buyer would type into Google, e.g. "commercial robotic mower". Defaults to the job plus "robot".

startUrls.title: Vendor pages (optional)
startUrls.description: Product pages to read instead of searching Google.

maxSites.title: Max sites from Google
maxSites.description: How many websites to read from Google results (one page each). Each page can list several robots.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Sites that answer 403 are blocking bots. Residential proxies get past most of them. Switch to automatic (datacenter) proxies if your plan has no residential traffic.

anthropicApiKey.title: Anthropic API key
anthropicApiKey.description: Used to read each page with Claude Haiku. Stored encrypted.
